unresolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-05 closed operation registry
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The v2 action registry has no closed action types or strict accepted, no-change, and rejected inputs for manual merged-payment creation, merged-payment source intake, explicit candidate confirmation, item-receipt evidence merge, allocation failure handling, and idempotent retries.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed RG-05 actions for manual creation, source intake, candidate confirmation, item-receipt evidence binding, rejected allocation attempts, and no-change retries. Each action must carry strict input or sparse attempted_input, explicit confirmation where required, deterministic IDs, complete deltas, and zero formal effects for pending, invalid, or incomplete input.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: An open or generic operation payload could infer categories, accounts, allocations, or confirmations and would weaken zero-effect rejection and idempotency guarantees.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Merged-payment import source and candidate payloads
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The current source and candidate unions do not register closed bank-payment and item-fact payloads for a merged payment, including immutable item times, suggested categories, provenance, confidence, completeness, and explicit confirmation requirements.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed merged-payment bank and item source payloads and a merged-payment candidate payload that preserve total, currency, bank fact, two item facts, source/evidence identities, immutable observed times, suggested categories, rule provenance, confidence, status history, and required explicit confirmation without creating formal postings.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Discarding or flattening these facts would prevent a pending candidate from retaining provenance, while inventing missing categories or payment facts would violate confirmation authority.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: merged_payment relation payload
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The relation registry reserves merged_payment but has no closed payload that can tie two item-allocation identities to one formal expense transaction and its one real payment posting.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register a closed system-managed merged_payment relation with a stable instance ID, display name, one formal transaction member, one payment posting member, two item-allocation members, currency, payment total, and a prohibition on generic order lifecycle or a second economic event. The relation must enforce one unique real payment posting and allocations that exactly equal its payment total.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Encoding this business relation as a generic relation or an independent payment entity could duplicate a payment, merge the two consumption identities, or allow an unbalanced allocation total.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Independent consumption and item-allocation lifecycle payloads
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The minimal registered consumption_record and item_allocation payloads cannot retain RG-05 details, immutable item source time, source/item bindings, allocation evidence identity, shared-payment membership, completeness, and the boundary that prevents item-level statistics-time override.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Extend or register closed RG-05 lifecycle payloads that preserve each independent consumption record and item allocation with details, source bindings, immutable observed time, common payment statistics time, completeness, and relation membership. Keep the current canonical amount/category/expense-posting fields and prohibit an item allocation from creating a second transaction or payment.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Collapsing records or treating an item allocation as a payment would lose category/detail identity and permit duplicate cash flow or altered statistics attribution.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-05 bank-payment and item-receipt evidence payloads
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The evidence union does not register closed bank-payment and item-receipt evidence payloads for RG-05, despite existing typed evidence-link targets and roles.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed evidence payloads for the bank debit and per-item receipt. The bank link must use real_account_posting against only the unique asset posting and may affect posting reconciliation; each receipt must use item_allocation_fact against exactly one item_allocation domain entity and may affect only business evidence completeness.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Transaction-level or consumption-record receipt links could falsely reconcile expense postings, while untyped evidence could duplicate formal entities during a later receipt merge.
